newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville plans March 11 meeting on federal power.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville plans March 11 meeting on federal power.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) will hold a "kickoff" meeting March 11 in Portland, Ore., for review of the federal power subscription process.
The meeting, which will be open to the public, will include an overview of the process and the tentative schedule for its completion, BPA said.
The federal power marketing agency also said the meeting will address how to meet the goals of a comprehensive review of the Northwest energy system which was released by a task force late last year.

That report, put together by representatives of Idaho, Montana, Oregon and Washington, recommended that the bulk of federal power generated in the region should be sold through a subscription process which would let utilities purchase it under long- or short-term contracts.
